generationCalls: 2 (the three-pose strip, and one blink edit of the front pose); see art/scratch/generation-log.jsonl

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-raccoon.ts (rebuilds the atlas byte for byte)
postProcessing.extract: each pose found as a whole figure by the gaps between figures (extract-strip.ts); fixed thirds of the strip cut one tail flat and left a piece of it beside the next pose
postProcessing.key: #00FF00 border flood plus enclosed holes, 18% fuzz (the visible edge band peaks at a green excess of 20 to 28; 45% changed nothing that mattered)
postProcessing.cleanup: at sprite size, drop-islands.ts --min 120, then despill-edge.ts --key green --band 2

frames.down_idle_02: the blink edit of the front pose (a smug squint)
frames.right_idle_01: the strip's third pose (three-quarter right, waving)

selectionReason: The strip matches the concept: purple patchwork hood, teal collar, spiral eyes, a big grin, a striped tail. Mischief, not menace. The second pose was unused.
